subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Surge
solution:
The correct answer is **Rise.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Surge: **a sudden powerful forward or upward movement.

 
 
• ***​Example:*** There was a sudden surge in the demand for sanitizers with the outbreak of Covid-19.
 
 
 
• ** Rise**: an upward movement.
 
• Thus, the appropriate synonym of** the surge **is **rise**. 
 
• The correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fall: **move from a higher to a lower level.
 
• **Need: **Necessity.
 
• **Lack: **the state of being without or not having enough of something.
